_note: PRIORITY SEARCH RESULT: after an exhaustive search (Wikimedia Commons colour + categories, Atlas of Mutual Heritage, Rijksmuseum, Pallegoix 1854, Delaporte/Garnier Indo-Chine, Mouhot, Carl Bock 'Temples and Elephants' 1884, plus web searches), NO public-domain COLOUR illustrated VIEW of Chiang Mai or northern Thailand (Lanna) could be found. Colour PD Thai imagery is overwhelmingly of central Siam (Ayutthaya, Bangkok). Every Chiang Mai / Doi Suthep / Lanna-temple result on Commons is a modern photograph (barred by the illustration rule) or a monochrome 19th-century engraving (the earlier pass). The single colour PD item that even touches northern Thailand is the Carl Bock route map below, and it is a line map, not a hero-quality view.
title: Route from Bangkok to Kiang-Tsen (Chiang Saen), Siam / Lao states
collection: From 'Temples and Elephants: The Narrative of a Journey of Exploration through Upper Siam and Lao' (London, 1884), via Wikimedia Commons
border: Framed cartographic sheet with a printed neat-line border; tall portrait format (roughly 1:2.5). Border and title cartouche would need trimming.
fit: WEAK / NOT RECOMMENDED as a plate. A mostly-monochrome engraved line map (its only real colour is a thin red route line and aged-paper tone) tracing the journey north through Lampoon, Lakhon and Chiang Mai up to Chiang Saen in the Lanna north. Included only to document that this is the ONLY colour PD item found that depicts northern Thailand at all. It is a map, not an illustrated cityscape/landscape, and its extreme portrait aspect ratio is wrong for a hero/thumbnail. Recommendation: do not use; either keep a monochrome Chiang Mai engraving or switch the pin to a colour-rich Thai alternative (see ../thailand-alt).
